answer: In an agent marketplace, zephyr, comet and oasis can label service pools, but opening a new pool must not create trust. Each validator locks a separate bond for each active seat; stake cannot back two seats at once. Random audits sample claimed work, and a public proof of double-signing burns that seat's bond during a delayed withdrawal window. An attacker holding n seats must immobilize n bonds and risks n losses when caught. This raises the cost of a farm; it does not prove unique ownership, and audit coverage must stay unpredictable.
